TEXT: Choose from multiple relic options per tier. Configurable (default: 1 additional).

This page configures how many choices you get when a relic of a particular tier is found. Each tier can be configured separately. For example, if the reward is a Common relic, and the slider for Common is set to 2, you will get the original Common relic plus 2 additional choices.

Offer skipped relics again when a tier runs out

This page configures whether additional relic choices share the tier of the original reward, or have a chance to come from a different tier. Adjust the chance and magnitude of tier changes, and use the checkboxes to decide which tiers are eligible.

Click a relic to exclude it from Picky Relics. Excluded relics are never offered as additional choices, and when an excluded relic is the reward it is awarded as-is, with no extra choices. Excluded relics still drop normally from combat, shops, chests, and events.
